parameters.name: ModesSupported
parameters.description: The security modes that the Security Controller can support. Refer to {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 9.2}}.

parameters.name: ModeEnabled
parameters.description: The security mode in which the Security Controller is operating.

parameters.name: MICSize
parameters.description: The selected MIC size used in the domain.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: Indicates whether the Security Controller is above the L1 reference point. It is set to {{true}} if the Security Controller is above the L1 reference point, and set to {{false}} otherwise.

object.description: This object specifies management parameters pertaining to the Security Controller functionality (Security Controller function; see {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 9.2}}). The object exists only on G.hn interfaces that are currently the Security Controller, i.e. for which parameter {{param|#.IsSC}} is {{true}}.
